verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ikpe ivẹ soso vwọ wan nu, Fero da vwerhẹ evwerhẹ nẹ ọye de mudia orhoma rọ urhie ri Nile,
verses.text_romanized: re ikpe ive soso vwo wan nu fero da vwerhe evwerhe ne oye de mudia orhoma ro urhie ri nile

verses.text_urhobo: o vwo ni, irhuẹn ighwrẹ sọkọ sọkọ tubie tubie de nẹ evun rẹ urhie na rhe, kẹ ayen ria ẹgo rẹ oma rẹ urhie na.
verses.text_romanized: o vwo ni irhuen ighwre soko soko tubie tubie de ne evun re urhie na rhe ke ayen ria ego re oma re urhie na

verses.text_urhobo: O rhe vwo ni, irhuẹn ighwrẹ efa dọndọn grosi da vwọ kpahe ayen nẹ evun rẹ urhie na rhe, ayen de mudia kẹrẹ irhuẹn ri chekọ na vwẹ orhoma rẹ urhie na.
verses.text_romanized: o rhe vwo ni irhuen ighwre efa dondon grosi da vwo kpahe ayen ne evun re urhie na rhe ayen de mudia kere irhuen ri cheko na vwe orhoma re urhie na

verses.text_urhobo: Irhuẹn re dọndọn grosi na de mu iride tubie tubie na rọ. Fero de gbunie rhọvwọ.
verses.text_romanized: irhuen re dondon grosi na de mu iride tubie tubie na ro fero de gbunie rhovwo

verses.text_urhobo: O de sheruo ovwerhẹ o da vwerhẹ evwerhẹ obo rivẹ; o vwo ni, eduru rẹ eka ighwrẹ gbuke yoyovwi, da djẹ vwẹ ugbẹn rẹ ọka ọvo.
verses.text_romanized: o de sheruo ovwerhe o da vwerhe evwerhe obo rive o vwo ni eduru re eka ighwre gbuke yoyovwi da dje vwe ugben re oka ovo

verses.text_urhobo: Mi rhe vwo ni, eduru rẹ eka ighwrẹ re vwara ẹbe gẹngẹn rẹ odju bẹre de rhe mu kpahe erẹ ẹsosuọ na.
verses.text_romanized: mi rhe vwo ni eduru re eka ighwre re vwara ebe gengen re odju bere de rhe mu kpahe ere esosuo na

verses.text_urhobo: Ere pha gẹngẹn na de mu ighwrẹ re pha gbuke na rọ Fero da rhọvwọ rhe,
verses.text_romanized: ere pha gengen na de mu ighwre re pha gbuke na ro fero da rhovwo rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Rẹ ọke vwo rhie re, udu ko bro, o de re se ẹboepha rẹ Ijipt ejobi kugbe ebuiroro ejobi, Fero da ta evwerhẹ na vwọ kẹ ayen, ẹkẹvuọvo a mrẹ ohwo ọvuọvo rọ sa fan otọ rọye ki Fero-o.
verses.text_romanized: re oke vwo rhie re udu ko bro o de re se eboepha re ijipt ejobi kugbe ebuiroro ejobi fero da ta evwerhe na vwo ke ayen ekevuovo a mre ohwo ovuovo ro sa fan oto roye ki fero o

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin onotu rẹ omuidi na da ta ki Fero, Me karophihọ obrabra mẹ nonẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin onotu re omuidi na da ta ki fero me karophiho obrabra me none na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ivun vwo miovwo Fero kpahe idibo rọye, ro vwo mu vwe vẹ onotu rẹ ọkakemu phihọ uwodi vwẹ obo uwevwi rẹ onotu rẹ idugbu na,
verses.text_romanized: oke re ivun vwo miovwo fero kpahe idibo roye ro vwo mu vwe ve onotu re okakemu phiho uwodi vwe obo uwevwi re onotu re idugbu na

verses.text_urhobo: avwanre da vwerhẹ evwerhẹ vwẹ ason ọvuọvo na, te ọye te omẹvwẹ, dohwo devwerhẹ rọye dohwo dotọ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: avwanre da vwerhe evwerhe vwe ason ovuovo na te oye te omevwe dohwo devwerhe roye dohwo doto roye

verses.text_urhobo: Emeghene ri Hibru rọ vẹ avwanre gba Etiyin na, odibo rẹ onotu rẹ idugbu na; ọke rẹ avwanre vwọ ta evwerhẹ na kẹ re, ọ da fan otọ rẹ evwerhẹ na kẹ avwanre, dohwo dotọ rọye kirobo rẹ evwerhẹ na epha.
verses.text_romanized: emeghene ri hibru ro ve avwanre gba etiyin na odibo re onotu re idugbu na oke re avwanre vwo ta evwerhe na ke re o da fan oto re evwerhe na ke avwanre dohwo doto roye kirobo re evwerhe na epha

verses.text_urhobo: Kirobo rọ fan otọ rẹ evwerhẹ na kẹ avwanre te eriyin ọ wanre; a rhoma reyọ ovwẹ vwo kpo ako re iruo mẹ, onotu rẹ ọkakemu na e de churo si.
verses.text_romanized: kirobo ro fan oto re evwerhe na ke avwanre te eriyin o wanre a rhoma reyo ovwe vwo kpo ako re iruo me onotu re okakemu na e de churo si

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Fero de ji ikọ re se Josẹf, e de sio nẹ emwa na kpata kpata; rọ vwọ wanre etọ rọye nu ro vwo wene amwa rọye nu, o de rhi mudia obaro ri Fero.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin fero de ji iko re se josef e de sio ne emwa na kpata kpata ro vwo wanre eto roye nu ro vwo wene amwa roye nu o de rhi mudia obaro ri fero

verses.text_urhobo: Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Me vwerhẹ evwerhẹ, a rha mrẹ ohwo ọvuọvo rọ sa fan otọ rọye-e; mi nyori nẹ a da ta evwerhẹ kẹ wẹ ku wọ sa fan otọ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: fero da ta ki josef me vwerhe evwerhe a rha mre ohwo ovuovo ro sa fan oto roye e mi nyori ne a da ta evwerhe ke we ku wo sa fan oto roye

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf da kpahe ki Fero, Ọ evun mẹẹ, Ọghẹnẹ re sa fan otọ rọ gbare ki Fero.
verses.text_romanized: josef da kpahe ki fero o evun mee oghene re sa fan oto ro gbare ki fero

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Nighe, vwẹ evun rẹ evwerhẹ mẹ mi de mudia vwẹ orhoma rẹ urhie ri Nile,
verses.text_romanized: etiyin fero da ta ki josef nighe vwe evun re evwerhe me mi de mudia vwe orhoma re urhie ri nile

verses.text_urhobo: irhuẹn ighwrẹ sọkọ sọkọ tubie tubie, de nẹ evun ri Nile rhe ke ria ẹgo vwẹ oma rẹ urhie;
verses.text_romanized: irhuen ighwre soko soko tubie tubie de ne evun ri nile rhe ke ria ego vwe oma re urhie

verses.text_urhobo: irhuẹn ighwrẹ efa dọndọn grosi, da vwọ kpahe ayen nẹ evun rẹ urhie na rhe, Me je mrẹ oghẹre tiọna vwẹ Ijipt na dẹvo-o.
verses.text_romanized: irhuen ighwre efa dondon grosi da vwo kpahe ayen ne evun re urhie na rhe me je mre oghere tiona vwe ijipt na devo o

verses.text_urhobo: Irhuẹn ighwrẹ dọndọn grosi na de mu ere ẹsosuọ ighwrẹ na ri tubie tubie na rọ,
verses.text_romanized: irhuen ighwre dondon grosi na de mu ere esosuo ighwre na ri tubie tubie na ro

verses.text_urhobo: ẹkẹvuọvo rẹ ayen vwọ rọ ayen nu ohwo ọvuọvo sa riẹn nẹ ayen rọ aye-en, kidie ayen je pha dọndọn kirobo rẹ ayen epha jovwo. Kọye mi de gbunie rhe.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo re ayen vwo ro ayen nu ohwo ovuovo sa rien ne ayen ro aye en kidie ayen je pha dondon kirobo re ayen epha jovwo koye mi de gbunie rhe

verses.text_urhobo: Me da je mrẹ vwẹ evun rẹ evwerhẹ mẹ na, eduru re eka ighwrẹ re djẹ rhe vwẹ ugbẹ ọvo, gbuke yoyovwi;
verses.text_romanized: me da je mre vwe evun re evwerhe me na eduru re eka ighwre re dje rhe vwe ugbe ovo gbuke yoyovwi

verses.text_urhobo: eduru rẹ eka ighwrẹ efa, gẹngẹn, re vwara ẹbe, rẹ odju bẹre, ri mu kpahe ighwrẹ rẹ ẹsosuọ na,
verses.text_romanized: eduru re eka ighwre efa gengen re vwara ebe re odju bere ri mu kpahe ighwre re esosuo na

verses.text_urhobo: eduru rẹ eka re gẹngẹn na da rọ iri gbuke yoyovwi na. Me tarọ kẹ ẹboepha ejobi, ẹkẹvuọvo o vwo ohwo rọ sa fan otọ rọye kẹ vwẹ-ẹ.
verses.text_romanized: eduru re eka re gengen na da ro iri gbuke yoyovwi na me taro ke eboepha ejobi ekevuovo o vwo ohwo ro sa fan oto roye ke vwe e

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Josẹf da ta ki Fero, Evwerhẹ ri Fero na ọvuọvo; Ọghẹnẹ vwọ phia ki Fero obo ro che ru.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin josef da ta ki fero evwerhe ri fero na ovuovo oghene vwo phia ki fero obo ro che ru

verses.text_urhobo: Irhuẹn ighwrẹ ri yoyovwi na eye ikpe ighwrẹ, eduru rẹ eka ighwrẹ ri yoyovwi na eye jẹ ikpe ighwrẹ; evwerhẹ na ọvuọvo
verses.text_romanized: irhuen ighwre ri yoyovwi na eye ikpe ighwre eduru re eka ighwre ri yoyovwi na eye je ikpe ighwre evwerhe na ovuovo

verses.text_urhobo: Irhuẹn ighwrẹ re dọndọn grosi na, re vwọ kpahe ayen na eye ikpe ighwrẹ, vẹ eduru rẹ eka re gẹngẹn re vwara ẹbe na rẹ odju bẹre na, eye ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ owẹvwe
verses.text_romanized: irhuen ighwre re dondon grosi na re vwo kpahe ayen na eye ikpe ighwre ve eduru re eka re gengen re vwara ebe na re odju bere na eye ikpe ighwre re owevwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ pha kirobo re Me ta ki Fero na, Ọghẹnẹ rhe vwọ phia ki Fero obo ro che ru.
verses.text_romanized: o pha kirobo re me ta ki fero na oghene rhe vwo phia ki fero obo ro che ru

verses.text_urhobo: Ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ ororo cha rhe vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt na ejobi,
verses.text_romanized: ikpe ighwre re ororo cha rhe vwe oto re ijipt na ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: ẹkẹvuọvo ororo na de notọ nu ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ owẹvwe kọ cha rhe, okuvwe na ejobi ke cha chọẹro vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt na, owẹvwe na fi gangan vwẹ otọ na,
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo ororo na de noto nu ikpe ighwre re owevwe ko cha rhe okuvwe na ejobi ke cha choero vwe oto re ijipt na owevwe na fi gangan vwe oto na

verses.text_urhobo: ororo na a gbe karophihọ-ọ fiki re owẹvwe ọgangan ro che nene na, kidie ọ cha gan gangan.
verses.text_romanized: ororo na a gbe karophiho o fiki re owevwe ogangan ro che nene na kidie o cha gan gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Evwerhẹ na rẹ ọhwọhwọ ivẹ na dje phia nẹ Ọghẹnẹ bru ẹdẹ na nure, Ọghẹnẹ kọ cha vwọ phia nanana.
verses.text_romanized: evwerhe na re ohwohwo ive na dje phia ne oghene bru ede na nure oghene ko cha vwo phia nanana

verses.text_urhobo: Ọtiọye na e gbe ji Fero sanọ ohwo rọ ghwanre vẹ ọhọ, rere o vwo mu vwẹ Ijipt na ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: otioye na e gbe ji fero sano ohwo ro ghwanre ve oho rere o vwo mu vwe ijipt na ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: E gbe ji Fero vwẹ ilori mu buebu vwẹ otọ na, rere e toro ẹko-uri rẹ obo re vuru nẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt na rhe vwẹ ọke rẹ ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ ororo na.
verses.text_romanized: e gbe ji fero vwe ilori mu buebu vwe oto na rere e toro eko uri re obo re vuru ne oto re ijipt na rhe vwe oke re ikpe ighwre re ororo na

verses.text_urhobo: Ja ghwẹ emu nana re toro cha na ejobi koko vwẹ ọgangan ri Fero, vwẹ orere ọvuọvo, rere a sẹro rayen.
verses.text_romanized: ja ghwe emu nana re toro cha na ejobi koko vwe ogangan ri fero vwe orere ovuovo rere a sero rayen

verses.text_urhobo: Rere a sẹro rẹ emu na koko vwọ hẹrhẹ ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ owẹvwe ro che fi vwẹ Ijipt na, rere owẹvwe vwo jẹn ihwo na ehwe ghwẹ vwe evun rẹ otọ na.
verses.text_romanized: rere a sero re emu na koko vwo herhe ikpe ighwre re owevwe ro che fi vwe ijipt na rere owevwe vwo jen ihwo na ehwe ghwe vwe evun re oto na

verses.text_urhobo: Iroro nana de shephihọ ki Fero vẹ idibo rọye ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: iroro nana de shephiho ki fero ve idibo roye ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Fero da ta kẹ idibo rọye nẹ, Ke avwanre sa mrẹ ohwo ọtiọnana, re erhi rẹ Ọghẹnẹ rheri?
verses.text_romanized: fero da ta ke idibo roye ne ke avwanre sa mre ohwo otionana re erhi re oghene rheri

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Rẹ Ọghẹnẹ vwọ vwẹ emu na ejobi phia kẹ wẹ na, o rhe vwo ohwo ọvuọvo rọ ghwanre no wẹ-ẹ;
verses.text_romanized: koye fero da ta ki josef re oghene vwo vwe emu na ejobi phia ke we na o rhe vwo ohwo ovuovo ro ghwanre no we e

verses.text_urhobo: ko wẹ re cha dia enu rẹ uwevwi mẹ, ihwo mẹ ke vwẹ oma kpotọ kẹ wẹ sun, jokpa rẹ obo ekete mẹ Me da rho nọ wẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ko we re cha dia enu re uwevwi me ihwo me ke vwe oma kpoto ke we sun jokpa re obo ekete me me da rho no we

verses.text_urhobo: Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Nighe, Me vwẹ owẹ mu osun vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt.
verses.text_romanized: fero da ta ki josef nighe me vwe owe mu osun vwe oto re ijipt

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Fero da ghwiẹ isa nẹ obo rọye o de kuo phihọ obo ri Josẹf, o de ku adagba ọfuanfon phihọ oma, o de ku ọjọnrọn re oro phihọ ohọre;
verses.text_romanized: etiyin fero da ghwie isa ne obo roye o de kuo phiho obo ri josef o de ku adagba ofuanfon phiho oma o de ku ojonron re oro phiho ohore

verses.text_urhobo: ọ da vwẹ idjighere rọye rivẹ kẹ nẹ ọgua, ayen de ghwoghwo nẹ, We shiguẹ. Enẹ a vwi Josẹf mu vwẹ enu rẹ Ijipt.
verses.text_romanized: o da vwe idjighere roye rive ke ne ogua ayen de ghwoghwo ne we shigue ene a vwi josef mu vwe enu re ijipt

verses.text_urhobo: Ọfa, Fero da ta ki Josẹf, Mẹvwẹ Fero, ẹkẹvuọvo wọ rha rhọvwe-e ohwo ọvuọvo rha sa kpare obọ eye owọ vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt na-a.
verses.text_romanized: ofa fero da ta ki josef mevwe fero ekevuovo wo rha rhovwe e ohwo ovuovo rha sa kpare obo eye owo vwe oto re ijipt na a

verses.text_urhobo: Fero de se odẹ ri Josẹf Zafenatapanea; ọ da vwẹ Asenat, rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Potifera orherẹ ri On vwọ kẹ nẹ ọ vwọ rọvwọ. Kọye Josẹf de ki otọ rẹ Ijipt ejobi duvwu.
verses.text_romanized: fero de se ode ri josef zafenatapanea o da vwe asenat re omote ri potifera orhere ri on vwo ke ne o vwo rovwo koye josef de ki oto re ijipt ejobi duvwu

verses.text_urhobo: Ikpe ọgban Josẹf teri ọke rọ vwọ ro iruo ri Fero ovie rẹ Ijipt. Josẹf da yan nẹ obaro ri Fero, o de ki otọ rẹ Ijipt na ejobi duvwu.
verses.text_romanized: ikpe ogban josef teri oke ro vwo ro iruo ri fero ovie re ijipt josef da yan ne obaro ri fero o de ki oto re ijipt na ejobi duvwu

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ ororo na otọ na de yovwi emu gangan,
verses.text_romanized: vwe ikpe ighwre re ororo na oto na de yovwi emu gangan

verses.text_urhobo: o de koko emu vwẹ ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ ororo na vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt na ejobi, o de koko emu vwẹ irere na ejobi; a da ghwẹ emu na nẹ idju re riariẹ orere ọvuọvo na rhi koko.
verses.text_romanized: o de koko emu vwe ikpe ighwre re ororo na vwe oto re ijipt na ejobi o de koko emu vwe irere na ejobi a da ghwe emu na ne idju re riarie orere ovuovo na rhi koko

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf de koko eka buebu gbidi kiri ehavwo rẹ urhie, o rhi te ukuko na a gbe sa vwavwe aye-en, kidie ibunọ.
verses.text_romanized: josef de koko eka buebu gbidi kiri ehavwo re urhie o rhi te ukuko na a gbe sa vwavwe aye en kidie ibuno

verses.text_urhobo: Tavwe rẹ ikpe rẹ owẹvwe na ki rhi te, Josẹf vwiẹ emeshare ivẹ nure, rẹ Asenat, rẹ ọmọtẹ ri Potifera rẹ orhere ri On, vwiẹ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: tavwe re ikpe re owevwe na ki rhi te josef vwie emeshare ive nure re asenat re omote ri potifera re orhere ri on vwie ke

verses.text_urhobo: Josẹf de se odẹ rẹ ọwanra rọye na Manasse, Kidie, ọ tare nẹ, Ọghẹnẹ nẹrhẹ oja mẹ ejobi kugbe uwevwi mẹ chọ ovwẹ ẹro.
verses.text_romanized: josef de se ode re owanra roye na manasse kidie o tare ne oghene nerhe oja me ejobi kugbe uwevwi me cho ovwe ero

verses.text_urhobo: Odẹ rẹ ọrivẹ o de se Ifrem, Kidie Ọghẹnẹ ru vwe phihọ ọmiọvwọ vwẹ otọ rẹ ukpokpogho mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ode re orive o de se ifrem kidie oghene ru vwe phiho omiovwo vwe oto re ukpokpogho me

verses.text_urhobo: Ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ ororo na da rhe gba vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt na;
verses.text_romanized: ikpe ighwre re ororo na da rhe gba vwe oto re ijipt na

verses.text_urhobo: ikpe ighwrẹ rẹ owẹvwe na ra rhẹrẹ cha, kirobo ri Josẹf tare. Owẹvwe de rhi fi vwẹ irere efa, ẹkẹvuọvo emuọre da rhe vọn otọ rẹ Ijipt.
verses.text_romanized: ikpe ighwre re owevwe na ra rhere cha kirobo ri josef tare owevwe de rhi fi vwe irere efa ekevuovo emuore da rhe von oto re ijipt

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ emuọre rẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt ejobi vwo re nu, ihwo na ejobi ki brenu rẹ emu hwe Fero, Fero da ta kẹ ihwo rẹ Ijipt, We bru Josẹf ra; obo rọ ta kẹ ovwan, we ru.
verses.text_romanized: oke re emuore re oto re ijipt ejobi vwo re nu ihwo na ejobi ki brenu re emu hwe fero fero da ta ke ihwo re ijipt we bru josef ra obo ro ta ke ovwan we ru

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ owẹvwe na rhi vwo fi ruo otọ na ejobi re, Josẹf de rhie evun rọye ejobi phihọ, ọ da shẹ emu kẹ ihwo rẹ Ijipt, fikiridie owẹvwe na ganre vwẹ otọ rẹ Ijipt na gangan.
verses.text_romanized: oke re owevwe na rhi vwo fi ruo oto na ejobi re josef de rhie evun roye ejobi phiho o da she emu ke ihwo re ijipt fikiridie owevwe na ganre vwe oto re ijipt na gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Ọrọmarho, ihwo rẹ akpọ na ejobi de kpo Ijipt bru Josẹf ra dẹ ọka, kidie owẹvwe na pha gangan vwẹ akpọ na ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: oromarho ihwo re akpo na ejobi de kpo ijipt bru josef ra de oka kidie owevwe na pha gangan vwe akpo na ejobi

headings.text_urhobo: Josẹf fan otọ re Evwerhẹ ri Fero
headings.text_romanized: josef fan oto re evwerhe ri fero

headings.text_urhobo: A vwi Josẹf ru Osun vwẹ Ijipt
headings.text_romanized: a vwi josef ru osun vwe ijipt
